scenes.headline: How a voice agent finds the right memory in time
scenes.sub: VoiceMem's dual-brain index: schemas, entities and a persona graph.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Linden! A voice agent has to recall what you told it last week, in the pause before it replies. Here's how VoiceMem does it.

scenes.text: Route the live transcript through a schema and entity index first, so search ranks a small, bounded pool instead of the whole memory store.
scenes.say: The idea: route the live transcript through an index first, so the search only ranks a small, bounded pool, never the whole memory store.

steps.say: As you speak, the partial transcript is matched against schemas: coarse topics like health, work and people.
Matching entities expand one hop along their links. Only their memories go into the candidate pool.
The backend search, Mem0 in the paper, ranks just that pool and hands back the top five.
In parallel, the right brain keeps a persona graph: lasting traits, and feelings tied to a person or event.

left.title: Routing switched off
left.say: Switch the schema routing off, and the same ranker can still get there. It just needs thirty results and three times the tokens.

right.title: Schema routing on
right.say: With routing on, the top five reach ninety-one point two percent, in a hundred and thirty-four milliseconds, flat as K grows.

scenes.title: The reply model's adapter, block by block

steps.say: The replies come from a QLoRA on Qwen3.6, a mixture of experts forty blocks deep.
The adapter attaches to the attention projections and the small shared expert in every block.

steps.note: one fused tensor, out of the adapter's reach
steps.say: The routed experts are stored as one fused tensor, so the adapter never reaches them: ninety-three percent of the tower.

scenes.text: Bounding the candidate pool before ranking is what keeps top-5 memory search fast and accurate inside a live voice turn.

recap: Schemas and entities bound the pool
A persona graph tracks traits and feelings
The reply adapter skips the routed experts
scenes.say: To recap: an index bounds the pool, a persona graph remembers feelings, and the adapter skips the experts.
